message: If a task cannot fit into today's available time, it is moved to the next suitable day.
Completed and cancelled tasks are removed from future scheduling.
If two tasks have similar priority scores (within 5 points), the one with the earlier deadline goes first.
Time before a task's deadline is used first; work only goes past a deadline when nothing else fits.
Blocks you customised manually are never moved or deleted automatically.
A break is inserted after every work block.
You missed {missed_blocks_recent} blocks in the last 7 days, so the daily workload is reduced by 25%.
Because of the missed blocks, time blocks are shortened by 25% to be more realistic.
Many missed blocks ({missed_blocks_recent}): workload is reduced by a further 20%.
